role: Robotics Automation Engineer – AR Glass Testing

adjacent_skills.you_have: DH tables, forward kinematics, URDF frames

key_responsibilities: Robotic automation for AR glasses validation

strengths: Physical UR5e hands-on: planned and executed collision-free pick-and-place on a real UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver, with hand-derived DH tables and 0T6 forward kinematics validated in MoveIt/RViz
Python plus Linux/Bash/Git depth across COFFIN (Flask-SocketIO, systemd, multiprocessing multi-camera capture) and a PyQt real-time data acquisition GUI at BARC
Computer vision depth: YOLO visual servoing with TensorRT, OpenCV-style image processing, BARC surface inspection pipeline with stitching, wavelet denoising and depth estimation
SE(3) coordinate-frame math engine (Frame Simulator) backs robot-to-device coordinate transforms; ADXL345 wearable glove with software calibration touches wearables and IMUs
real_gaps: No URScript, URX or RTDE; UR work went through the ROS 2 driver only
No force/torque control or force sensor integration
No automated test or regression framework, no DUT validation station or production test fixtures
No lab instrumentation automation: DAQ, programmable power supplies, DMMs driven from code (oscilloscope use is manual bench use)
No ADB, Wi-Fi or REST device-interface work
No AR/VR/XR optical validation: FOV, waveguide, display or camera image-quality testing
No explicit TCP calibration or hand-eye calibration procedure
Seniority: role asks 3+ years of validation or automation work, profile is capstone and internship scope
overstated_by_keywords: TCP/IP counted adjacent from WebSocket and static IP setup, which is not socket-level robot control
Oscilloscopes counted Have from bench use, not automated instrument control
Trajectory planning counted adjacent from MoveIt pick-and-place, not Cartesian/joint-space trajectory authoring with force control
understated_by_keywords: Mixed Reality headset concept and wearable glove at Planctech give genuine, if shallow, XR and wearable context
COFFIN's 11 integration failures resolved and multi-camera capture pipeline show real hardware debugging and root-cause work
screening_gaps: No URScript/RTDE/URX and no force/torque control: the named core robot-control stack is unevidenced
No test automation or validation-station experience: no automated regression frameworks or lab instrumentation (DAQ, power supplies) integration
No AR/optical device validation (FOV, display, camera quality) plus a 3+ year experience ask against capstone-scope work
llm_analysis.reasoning: UR5e hands-on, Python, Linux and computer vision are real and map to the robot-control and vision halves of the role. The test-automation, instrumentation and optical-validation half has no backing, and the UR work sits at the ROS driver level rather than URScript/RTDE. Partial fit worth applying to, with the screen-out risk concentrated in the 3+ years of validation experience.
